description: Remind a session to update the task graph after it edits a watched file (status.md, plan.md by default)

hooks.command: if [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook" post-tool; else exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook" post-tool; fi
if [ -n "$BASH_VERSION" ]; then . "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook" prompt; else exec bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/hook" prompt; fi
